sentences.text: The agreement imposes a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding when there is pre-payment or foreclosure. [E1, E2]
For this UCB loan, the current rule finding says pre-payment charge is not applicable. [R8]
That means Schedule II, row 3 conflicts with the current UCB rule position because the agreement includes a pre-payment charge while the current rule finding says it is not applicable. [E2, R8]
The older RBI pre-payment-charge directions and the floating-rate term-loan foreclosure-charge directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23, so they do not govern this question. [R1, R4]
